_comment: Template for data/reviewed/accepted_differences.json, which is private.
Structure only: the real file quotes values from the private baseline.
Every field of an accepted difference is required; a cell is accepted only if table, key, column, baseline and current all match.

accepted_differences.decision: the logged decision that produced this difference
accepted_differences.reason: why the new value is correct
accepted_differences.reference: where the decision and its evidence are recorded

obsolete_baseline_tables.reason: why the current pipeline no longer produces it
